name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Kharanos, Grif Wildheart sends a young dwarf hunter to face a snow leopard. This second trial follows the crag boar and tests a different kind of skill.

sections.title: A Lesson in Finesse
sections.body: Grif Wildheart points his students southeast of Kharanos, where snow leopards prowl Dun Morogh. The crag boar teaches a hunter to endure hard blows and raw force. The leopard demands another skill: meeting a swift, graceful predator on its own terms. Beneath its white coat lies dangerous strength, and Grif expects his students to learn how that strength strikes.

sections.title: Mastering the Taming Rod
sections.body: With an enchanted taming rod, you face a wild snow leopard and seek to turn its hunting instincts toward partnership. Its speed, agility, and sharp reflexes test you in ways the crag boar does not. A hunter who can work alongside a predator that strikes swiftly from the snowy crags is closer to mastering the beasts of the wild.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This is the second trial in the dwarf hunter rite of passage. Grif Wildheart asks you to test your skills against different beasts before he teaches you to form lasting bonds with animal companions.

faq.q: Where do I find the snow leopards?
aliases: where are snow leopards dun morogh
faq.answer: Snow leopards prowl the rocky crags and snowy slopes south and east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does Grif Wildheart want me to tame a leopard?
faq.answer: Grif Wildheart wants you to learn both brute strength and finesse. The crag boar relies on resilience, while the snow leopard teaches you to fight alongside a swift, agile, and deadly companion.

faq.q: Do I get to keep this snow leopard permanently?
aliases: can i keep the snow leopard
faq.answer: No. The beasts you tame in these first trials are temporary partners, bound by the taming rod's magic. When Grif considers your training complete, you can permanently tame any wild beast you choose.
Grif Wildheart, the dwarf hunter trainer outside the inn in Kharanos, Dun Morogh, assigns this trial.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: After you master the snow leopard, Grif sends you to face an Ice Claw Bear in a third and final taming trial. Then he teaches you to tame and train wild beasts on your own.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn how boars endure punishment while cats strike with speed and aggression.
As a dwarf, you share Dun Morogh's frozen peaks with snow leopards, whose stealth and hunting skill command respect.
